title: ISEMM-WRUH - EOCR-iSEM intelligent motor protection relay, 0.5–100 A, 100–240 VAC
range_short_desc: Intelligent smart energy monitoring and motor protection relay (EOCR-iSEM)
description: Schneider / Samwha EOCR-iSEM series intelligent motor protection and energy monitoring relay. The iSEMM is the current, voltage and power measuring model of the family: it protects on over/under current, earth fault, short circuit, stall, jam, phase loss, unbalance and reverse phase, and additionally on over/under voltage, over/low power and power factor. Current range 0.5–100 A definite (0.5–60 A on the inverse and thermal-inverse curves), system voltage 3-phase AC 110–690 V, control power 100–240 VAC. Reports over Modbus-RTU / RS-485 and converts the largest of the three phase currents to a 4–20 mA output. The relay body mounts behind the panel and drives a separate sPDM 72 × 72 mm display.

feature_groups.title: Main Feature
items: Measures and displays current, voltage, earth-fault current, active/reactive power, energy, operating time, total operating time and power factor
Fault-cause display, plus a fault wave record sampling 3-phase current and voltage at 1 ms for 200 ms around a trip (readable over communication)
Total operating-time counter that the user cannot reset — only cleared in the factory
Date and time stamping of faults, so a motor failure can be placed exactly
Restart limit caps reset attempts within 30 minutes when auto reset is enabled
Self test runs watchdog and RAM checks while the motor is not drawing current
Communication watchdog raises an alert if the PLC/DCS stops polling for a user-set 1–999 s

Jam operation time (Jt) : 0.2–10 s

Unbalance operation time (Cut) : 1–10 s

Low power setting (up) : 20–800% of a nominal 0.1–999 kW; operation time (upt) 1–30 s
